# Sand

<a href="Item-sand.md" title="Sand"><img src="icons/90.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Sand"></a>

A pale building material that can be smelted into [Glass](Item-glass.md).

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Placement | Place from the hotbar |

## How to obtain

Gather sand from sandy terrain, including desert surfaces and water beds, or crush one [Stone](Item-stone.md) or [Cobblestone](Item-cobblestone.md) into one sand in a powered [Crusher](Item-crusher.md).
